Cost: Provided with the Operating System
Slots: 6

Cyberdeck with 6 slots that take Programs or Hardware. Once per Round, when a Quickhack from this deck lands, the user may retry it with no Net Action on another valid target within 12m/yds that they already have access to.

Foundry notes:

  • Comes with the Operating System that requires it, so its price is 0 here.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Operating Systems > Cyberdeck Port Operating Systems).
